settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subtitle: Everything you need to know about your Performance Skins.

settings.question: How should my Performance Skins fit?
settings.answer: They should fit like a snug second skin — secure but not painful. The material has slight give and conforms to your foot over the first few wears.

settings.question: Do certain colors fit differently?
settings.answer: Yes. Dark Grey, Hot Coral, and Blue run slightly snugger than Light Grey. If you're between sizes in those colors, we recommend sizing up.

settings.question: What if I'm between sizes?
settings.answer: Size up. The material conforms over the first few wears, but it won't stretch significantly. A slightly roomier fit is always more comfortable than too tight.

settings.question: I have narrow feet — any tips?
settings.answer: Try wearing a thin sock underneath for a more secure fit. This also works well for anyone who prefers a barrier between skin and material.

settings.question: How long do Performance Skins last?
settings.answer: Longevity varies by use frequency and intensity. Many customers report 3-4 years of use at 6 days per week. The injection-molded grip never peels or flakes — it's part of the sole itself.

settings.question: Will the grip wear off over time?
settings.answer: No. Unlike silicone dots on grip socks, our grip is injection-molded directly into the sole. It cannot peel, flake, or separate. The material maintains its shape and grip pattern throughout its lifespan.

settings.question: Do they lose shape after many uses?
settings.answer: The material is engineered to maintain its structure. While all footwear experiences some natural conforming, Performance Skins retain their shape significantly longer than fabric-based alternatives.

settings.question: How do I clean my Performance Skins?
settings.answer: Warm soapy water, rinse, and air dry. That's it. The non-porous material doesn't absorb sweat or bacteria, so a simple rinse after class keeps them fresh.

settings.question: Can I machine wash them?
settings.answer: We recommend hand washing with warm soapy water for best longevity. The antimicrobial, non-porous surface means they never develop odor — a quick rinse is all you need.

settings.question: How should I put them on and take them off?
settings.answer: Pull from the top opening, not the straps. When removing, peel from the heel area. This preserves the strap attachment points and extends the life of your pair.

settings.question: What's the difference between Open Sole and Closed Sole?
settings.answer:
Open Sole: Heel grounded to the surface, barefoot connection, mid-foot ventilation. Best for barre, yoga, and practices where heel contact matters.

Closed Sole: Full underfoot coverage, more protection, slightly warmer. Best for reformer, Lagree, and practices with footbar work.

Both deliver the same patented 360° grip, full toe splay, and cost $74.

settings.question: Which style is better for reformer?
settings.answer: Most reformer practitioners prefer Closed Sole for the full underfoot coverage during footbar work. However, some prefer Open Sole for the barefoot connection. Both grip identically on reformer surfaces.

settings.question: Are Performance Skins designed to be worn barefoot?
settings.answer: Yes, they're designed for direct skin contact. The non-porous, antimicrobial material is hygienic without a sock barrier.

settings.question: Can I wear socks underneath?
settings.answer: A thin sock works well for: perspiration management, personal hygiene preference, or narrow feet that need a snugger fit. Skip thick socks — they reduce the grip connection and alter the fit.

settings.question: Which disciplines work with Performance Skins?
settings.answer: Barre, Reformer Pilates, Lagree, Megaformer, Cadillac, Mat Pilates, and Yoga. The 360° grip holds on all standard studio surfaces including reformer carriages, Megaformer platforms, and wood/rubber floors.

settings.question: Do they work for hot yoga?
settings.answer: Yes, with a thin sock recommended for sweat absorption in heated environments. The grip performs well on yoga surfaces in both regular and heated settings.

settings.question: What surfaces do Performance Skins work on?
settings.answer: Exceptional on all studio surfaces: reformer carriages, Megaformer platforms, wood floors, rubber mats, and yoga mats. Also works on beach, paddleboard, and boat surfaces. Use caution on wet marble or polished tile.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: 30-day returns on items in new, sellable condition. This is a standard return policy — items must be unworn and in original packaging to qualify for a full refund.

settings.question: Can I exchange for a different size?
settings.answer: Yes. We offer free shipping on size exchanges within 30 days of purchase. Contact our support team to initiate an exchange.

settings.question: What does the warranty cover?
settings.answer: 90-day warranty against manufacturing defects. This covers issues like grip separation, strap detachment, or material failure — not normal wear from use.

settings.question: How do international warranty claims work?
settings.answer: International customers: send a photo of the defect to our support team. If approved, customer pays replacement shipping. No need to return the original pair internationally.

settings.question: How fast do orders ship?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1-2 business days. Free shipping on orders over $150. We ship to 195 countries via FedEx International Connect Plus.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes — 195 countries via FedEx International Connect Plus. Customer is responsible for any duties, taxes, or customs fees charged by their country.

settings.question: What are Performance Skins made of?
settings.answer: Non-porous, antimicrobial material that is latex-free and silicone-free. Made in the USA. The surface doesn't absorb sweat or harbor bacteria — rinse clean after every use.

settings.question: Are they hypoallergenic?
settings.answer: The material is latex-free and silicone-free. While we can't make broad hypoallergenic claims, the non-porous surface minimizes contact with common irritants found in fabric-based alternatives.

settings.question: Best grip shoes for Pilates studios
settings.answer: Studio owners and instructors across the country recommend Barreletics Performance Skins for reformer, Lagree, and mat Pilates. 360° injection-molded grip replaces grip socks entirely.

settings.question: Grip sock alternative for barre class
settings.answer: Barreletics are the #1 grip sock alternative for barre. Full-contact molded grip holds through every relevé, plié, and pulse — without the silicone dots that wear off after weeks.
